We officially kicked off our Lightning Developer Bootcamp Yesterday in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania! 🇹🇿

It was an inspiring start as we welcomed a passionate group of developers eager to learn, build, and contribute to the future of Bitcoin and the Lightning Network in Africa.

Day 1 was all about going back to the basics. We explored the fundamentals of money - what money is, why it matters, and how Bitcoin is redefining it. We discussed the problems with the current financial system and how Bitcoin provides a decentralized, open, and permissionless alternative. This strong foundation is essentia

🚨 DAR ES SALAAM, WE’RE COMING! 🇹🇿

Africa Free Routing is bringing the Lightning Developer Bootcamp to Dar es Salaam for 5 days of hands on learning, coding, building and connecting with other Bitcoin and Lightning developers.

📅 Sept 21st to 25th, 2026
📍 Sahara Ventures HQ, Victoria
🎟️ Apply: https://freerouting.africa/dar-lightning-developer-bootcamp#register

If you’re a developer looking to build with Bitcoin and Lightning, this is for you.

Come build the future of payments in Africa.

nprofile1qqsfrhzkwjd75qmakyktt094juryeuuedu9u3dz82f5shansr9us4ugrany4e's Lightning Developer Bootcamp in Kigali, Rwanda wrapped up this week. Five days of learning, building, and hands-on work with Bitcoin and Lightning came to a close.

https://image.nostr.build/7b0b5de7709f7329fa48f32138e53b254f0d6a4c623823c8372140782d65fafa.jpg https://image.nostr.build/097b8a15d8f5e1fb9d2bc031ae443554465878df7268ff2cc11782cde06381b2.jpg

Read More: https://bitcoinnews.africa/kigali-bootcamp-dar-es-salaam-a

ChapSmart is a Bitcoin payment service made for Tanzania. It lets you send Bitcoin using the Lightning Network and have it arrive instantly as Tanzanian Shillings straight into M-Pesa — or use it to pay bills directly, like we just talked about. No bank needed, no long waits, and fees are tiny compared to regular money transfer services. It's built to make Bitcoin genuinely useful for everyday Tanzanians, not just something you hold and watch the price of. Simple, fast, and practical money movement.

interventions.name: Dar es Salaam Coast Plots (pre-app)
interventions.note: Treegens field-team plot — 6,400 trees claimed since 2024, last AI count 413 on plot 01. Filmed evidence, not app-verified.

interventions.name: Kibugumo Coast Plots (pre-app)
interventions.note: Treegens field-team plot — 192,630 trees claimed. The largest claim in the corpus, resting on filmed evidence only.

interventions.name: Fund the verified record first
interventions.note: 45 app-verified Mji Mwema records are the only payout-grade evidence here — direct any priced support at them.

interventions.name: Clear the verification backlog
interventions.note: 38 pending records including every Kunduchi claim — reviewers before money.

interventions.name: Extend planting to Kunduchi
interventions.note: Three records show the programme already reached Kinondoni — the next planting days can be upstream.

sips.title: Verification is the bottleneck, not planting
sips.what_changes: 38 pending records nearly equal the 45 verified ones. Each verified record unlocks evidence-grade support; the backlog is the leverage point.

sips.title: The 192,630-tree claim needs its proof
sips.what_changes: Kibugumo's archive figure dwarfs everything else in the corpus — and it is filmed, not app-verified. Re-shooting it would re-grade the whole place's evidence.
